datasets.description: Sudan Near Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sudan_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data monthly throughout 2021 across Sudan administrative units. Data were spatially encoded as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) with classification phases, scenarios, and collection metadata to represent the spatial distribution and temporal evolution of acute food insecurity conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic distribution.
